en.longDescription:
Umami is a simple, fast, and privacy-focused alternative to Google Analytics.

Includes PostgreSQL. Default login after first start: admin / umami — change the password immediately.

de.longDescription:

Enthält PostgreSQL. Standard-Login nach dem ersten Start: admin / umami — ändere das Passwort sofort.
